given_when_then.given: A Delivery Assignment has an initial status of 'Pending' and is updated to 'Assigned'
given_when_then.when: The system processes the status transition
given_when_then.then: The history log must display the sequence 'Pending' -> 'Assigned'.

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Assignment has a status of 'Assigned' and is updated to 'In-Transit'
given_when_then.when: The system processes the status transition
given_when_then.then: The history log must display the sequence 'Pending' -> 'Assigned' -> 'In-Transit'.

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Assignment is currently in 'In-Transit' and is updated to 'Delivered'
given_when_then.when: The system processes the status transition
given_when_then.then: The history log must display the sequence 'Pending' -> 'Assigned' -> 'In-Transit' -> 'Delivered'.

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Assignment is in 'Pending' status
given_when_then.when: The user attempts to set the status to 'Delivered' (skipping steps)
given_when_then.then: The system must prevent the status change as it does not follow the logical lifecycle.

given_when_then.given: A status change occurs via an automated system trigger
given_when_then.when: The change is recorded in the history log
given_when_then.then: The history log must include a status entry for the change with a timestamp.

given_when_then.given: A user attempts to modify a historical status entry for a completed Delivery Assignment
given_when_then.when: The system processes the modification request
given_when_then.then: The system must reject the request and the history entry must remain read-only.

success_criteria: The system preserves the complete sequence of previous status values in the history log to indicate the direction of change.
The system records a status entry for every state change, regardless of whether the trigger was manual or automated.
Historical status entries are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted after creation.
Each status entry in the history log includes a timestamp recorded in the system's standard time zone.
